snippet.title: Lost In Socks - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
3,000 socks. One house. Absolutely no idea where they all came from.

Lost in Socks is a 1–4 player co-op chaos game where you hunt down scattered socks, pair them up, and store them in your Archive before the house defeats you.

Play solo or with friends across three house sizes — from a quick 100-pair session to a full 1,500-pair catastrophe. Unlock 20 upgrades, wrangle your robot companion Roomy, and yes, there’s a cat.

🧦 WISHLIST / BUY ON STEAM
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1828470/Lost_in_Socks/
